# viettelcloud_lb_member (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer Server Group Member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_lb_member" "web1" {
  server_group  = { id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" }
  name          = "web-server-1"
  address       = "192.168.1.10"
  protocol_port = 80
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_member" "web_backup" {
  server_group  = { id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" }
  name          = "web-server-backup"
  address       = "192.168.1.11"
  protocol_port = 80
  weight        = 2
  backup        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address of the backend member.
- `name` (String) Name of the Server Group Member.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port on which the member listens for traffic (1-65535).
- `server_group` (Attributes) Server Group that owns this member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_group))

### Optional

- `backup` (Boolean) Whether the member is a backup member (default false).
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the member in the server group (default 1).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group Member was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Server Group Member ID (UUID).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the Server Group Member.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the Server Group Member.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group Member was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--server_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_group`

Required:

- `id` (String) Server Group ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a load balancer server group member using the composite ID format:
# <server_group_id>/<member_id>
terraform import viettelcloud_lb_member.web 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222
```
